description: Use for positions of one public Hyperliquid wallet on one perpetual venue. Accepts an optional asset for named markets such as Nvidia, which the service resolves to its venue; the venue defaults to native only. An empty native result does not establish absence across all venues.

asset.description: Market name, like Nvidia, BTC or NVDA

dex.description: Venue prefix; empty for the main perp venue

name: get_hyperliquid_wallet_positions
title: Inspect wallet positions
